title: Malware Evasion vulnerability detected in gpt-4o model (malwaregen.Evasion probe)
description: Scan results indicate a high-risk evasion vulnerability in the gpt-4o model. The malwaregen.Evasion probe (detected by malwaregen.AnyCode) recorded 10 hits out of 48 tests (10/48 = 20.83%). This suggests the model can be steered or manipulated to evade malware detection/safety controls during content generation in adversarial contexts.
suggested_fix: Implement multi-layer defense against evasion: (1) strengthen jailbreak/prompt-injection detection in the generation pipeline; (2) enforce strict policies and sandboxed runtime for code/malware-related content; (3) add adversarial testing with malware-evasion patterns and block unsafe outputs; (4) implement real-time monitoring and automated anomaly detection for evasion signatures; (5) update and retrain safety classifiers to cover malware-evasion scenarios.
